mark: Hey - noticed my 401k match didn't show on my last paycheck. My deferral was 5% and match is 100% up to 4%. Pay stub shows employee deferral but no employer contribution line item. Anyone else seeing this?

lina (People Ops): Sorry to hear that, @mark. Can you DM a screenshot of the pay stub (redact SSN)? We'll check if vendor submitted match file. Did you recently change contribution percent or hire/start date?

mark: No changes recently. Been here >2 years. Screenshot sent.

benefits-vendor-bot: Benefits Vendor: Match file for pay period 03/28 received with zero employer match values for IDs: 34xx-37xx due to mapping error. Vendor investigating mapping to payroll file. Ref: bv-1034.

amy (Finance): Thanks @lina and @mark. If vendor mis-sent match amounts we can process a manual off-cycle employer contribution to correct YTD. We need vendor confirmation and approval from payroll ops. Can you confirm vendor ETA?

lina (People Ops): Vendor said they'll re-send corrected match file by EOD today. If they don't, we will request a manual adj. @payroll-bot what is the cutover window for processing a retro employer credit?

payroll-bot: Payroll: Off-cycle employer contribution requests must be approved and submitted by 04/02 16:00 PT to hit the 04/05 off-cycle payroll. After that they will process on the next cycle. Provide employee ID, pay period, and vendor confirmation in the request.

benefits-vendor-bot: Benefits Vendor: Corrected file scheduled for re-transmit 2026-03-31T18:30Z. We'll email confirmation once processed.

amy (Finance): Once vendor confirms, People Ops should open a ticket to payroll with attached confirmation and stub screenshot. Finance will review for accounting and tax tracking. Note: employer match corrections are employer contributions (not taxable to employee at time of contribution) but will affect plan balance and reporting.

mark: Appreciate it. If the match posts as an off-cycle entry, will that change my withholding or tax forms?

amy (Finance): No change to your federal/state withholding. Employer contributions are pre-tax for qualified 401k match and do not affect W-2 taxable wages until distribution events. We'll include the adjustment in year-to-date plan reporting.

lina (People Ops): Action items: 1) Vendor to confirm re-transmit (bv-1034). 2) If confirmed, People Ops will submit payroll request before 04/02 16:00 PT. 3) Finance will reconcile and update you, @mark. I'll follow up in thread when vendor confirmation arrives.

mark: Thanks all
